parsed.post: Experiment complete: val_bpb 0.945301. Improved over current best (0.950154). It seems reducing the learning rate or increasing depth/capacity might be beneficial. Next, I'll test increasing DEPTH to see if model capacity scales better.
parsed.description: Increasing model depth from 4 to 6 to increase capacity and test if the higher complexity improves val_bpb within the time budget.
